reasoning: The deepseek model correctly assessed that the PKGBUILD downloads a prebuilt binary from the package's own upstream domain (static.ampcode.com) over HTTPS with pinned SHA-256 checksums. The version resolution via curl in latestver() is a standard AUR pattern and does not execute fetched content. No malicious injection or supply chain risks are present.
disagreement_analysis: The qwen model returned 'inconclusive' solely due to LLM API errors (HTTP 400) when attempting to review the PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO files, not due to any security concerns. The deepseek model successfully reviewed all files and found them safe. The openrouter report is advisory only and does not count as a vote.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO due to LLM API errors (HTTP 400), resulting in an inconclusive verdict for those files.
learnings: Implement retry mechanisms for LLM API calls to prevent transient HTTP 400 errors from causing incomplete audits and false inconclusive verdicts.
When a model fails to audit critical files due to tool/API errors, the orchestration layer should automatically trigger a re-audit with a fallback model rather than accepting an inconclusive verdict.
